profile.title: Alfonso Reyes

profile.summary: Alfonso Reyes co-developed Organizational Systems as a synthesis of complexity, organisational cybernetics, VSM and methodology.
profile.why_it_matters: His co-authorship is part of the book's intellectual and practical provenance and should not disappear behind a single-author account of organisational cybernetics.
common_misreadings: the book is solely Espejo's work
